opening.argument: The presentation shows Coinbase Wallet's functions: a wallet screen displays Buy, Swap, Send, Receive, and Scan controls, while a title card describes trading crypto across more networks. The description presents the new design, token support, and multichain dapp browser as product features. Its closing screen directs viewers to Google Play and the App Store, ordinary channels for obtaining the wallet. The description also states that nothing discussed is intended as investment advice. The cryptocurrency and trading references therefore describe what the wallet can do; the cited material contains no promise of returns or deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Beautiful new design. Hundreds of thousands of tokens. Multichain dapp browser.
Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.
